content.title: Nobody's Isle
content.theme: The Odyssey's Cyclops restaged on an Aegean shore: a shipwrecked crew, a smoking cave, and a captain whose only weapon is his wits.
content.premise: Your galley lies broken on the strand of a small green island, its crew huddled around a driftwood fire while the surf gnaws at the wreck. Above the meadows a single thread of smoke curls from a cave in the mountain's face, where something far larger than a man keeps its flock. You have no ship left to run to and no spear worth the name; before this island is done with you, cleverness is the only blade you will carry.

boundary.message: The surf drags at your legs and hauls you back toward the sand.
